summary: Fix pass applied and committed (781568c). Every ruling now reaches the phases: P3 synthesises the kubeconfig from the pod's ServiceAccount and P4's reattach shares it (F3), credential-map.md re-derives the outside-namespace leaves from providers.tf + setup-env.sh under the ruled superset rule (F4), and new P7 (Target ../AnsibleSpecs) writes the four-argument contract into the argo-cd/ model so slice 009 plans against it (F1). Blocking F2 fixed by re-reading approle.yml end to end — it names its consumers in ten loops, not five, and the two the old list omitted are the role_id/secret_id reads the staging tasks read back from; the bullet now states the outcome and the mid-play failure instead of a checklist. Advisories F5/F6 taken: V10 gains the deploy-owed escape, P6 names the render gate's hard-coded tag literal and its substring match. verification.json is 20 criteria (V19 kubernetes-provider identity, V20 the model's contract); plan parses clean under run_loop.py --dry-run with all seven Targets resolving.
